title: Monitor international rates
goal: Every currency the venture deals in has a recorded rate with its source and the time it was read, the rate used for each purpose is the one the policy names, and the movement since the last run is reported.

steps.do: List every currency the venture holds, bills in, pays in or is owed in, and name the one its books are kept in.
Record for each currency the rate used, where it came from and the date and time it was read, and say which rate the policy requires for each purpose, a daily rate, a period-end rate or an average.

consider.why: A figure converted at a rate nobody recorded cannot be checked or repeated.
consider.when: The venture holds, bills or pays in more than one currency.

steps.do: Report how far each rate has moved since the last run and what that move did to the cash position, to what is owed to the venture and to what it owes, naming the records behind each figure.

consider.why: A rate move can take more out of the position than a month of spend.
consider.when: A rate recorded in an earlier run has moved enough to matter to the cash position.

steps.do: Raise any rate the records cannot source as a decision for the founder to settle, and record on the handoff that this process does not apply when the venture deals in one currency only.

done_criteria.check: Does every rate carry its source and the date and time it was read, and is the rate used for each purpose the one the policy names?
